concept.heading: Advanced Algorithms
bullets: **Dijkstra's:** Shortest path in weighted graph (no negative edges). Min-heap.

problems.title: Reconstruct Itinerary
problems.keyInsight: Eulerian path - visit every edge exactly once. Use DFS with sorted adjacency lists. Add to result in postorder (Hierholzer's algorithm).

problems.title: Min Cost to Connect All Points
problems.keyInsight: Minimum Spanning Tree. Prim's: start from any node, greedily add cheapest edge to unvisited node using min-heap.

code.python:
def minCostConnectPoints(points):
    n = len(points)
    visited = set()
    heap = [(0, 0)]  # (cost, point_idx)
    total = 0
    while len(visited) < n:
        cost, i = heapq.heappop(heap)
        if i in visited: continue
        visited.add(i)
        total += cost
        for j in range(n):
            if j not in visited:
                dist = abs(points[i][0]-points[j][0]) + abs(points[i][1]-points[j][1])
                heapq.heappush(heap, (dist, j))
    return total

problems.title: Network Delay Time
problems.keyInsight: Classic Dijkstra. Find shortest path from source to ALL nodes. Answer = max of all shortest paths (time for last node to receive signal).

problems.title: Swim in Rising Water
problems.keyInsight: Modified Dijkstra on grid. "Distance" = max elevation along path. Min-heap by max elevation. Find path minimizing the maximum.

problems.title: Alien Dictionary
problems.keyInsight: Compare adjacent words to find ordering constraints (edges). Build graph, topological sort. If cycle exists, return "".

problems.title: Cheapest Flights Within K Stops
problems.keyInsight: Bellman-Ford with K+1 iterations (K stops = K+1 edges max). Each iteration relaxes all edges once.
